Marathi subject in SSC or equivalent examination or pass Marathi language test. Specific relaxations for Medical Records Technicians and other cadres as per circular.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the BMC Chief Clerk (Qualified) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BMC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BMC Chief Clerk (Qualified) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the BMC Chief Clerk (Qualified) recruitment is 06-10-2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the starting date for the online application process?
faq.answer: The online application process for the BMC Chief Clerk (Qualified) recruitment begins on 16-09-2026. Ensure you submit your application within the specified window.

faq.question: Q3. What is the official website for BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) recruitment is https://portal.mcgm.gov.in. All application-related activities and information will be available here.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Chief Clerk (Qualified) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Chief Clerk (Qualified) post ranges from Rs. 41800 to Rs. 132300 per month, as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level M-23.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Chief Clerk (Qualified) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have 5 years of service as an Executive Assistant (Clerk) or equivalent, a computer certificate (CCC or equivalent), and have studied Marathi in SSC or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the provided data, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Chief Clerk (Qualified) position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Online Objective Examination of 100 marks and 100 minutes, followed by the creation of a Merit List for Promotion.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Clerk (Qualified) post?
faq.answer: The notification indicates that there are 0 vacancies available for the Chief Clerk (Qualified) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this BMC recruitment is साप्रवि/३७६/मप dated 03-04-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the BMC Chief Clerk (Qualified) recruitment is strictly online. Candidates must apply through the official website within the given dates.
